title: 09 Documents in Foreign Trade - Topic Quiz

questions.text: Which transport document is issued for ocean shipping by container vessel (such as Shanghai to Rotterdam)?
options: Road Consignment Note (CMR)
Air Waybill (AWB)
Bill of Lading (B/L)
Rail Consignment Note (CIM)

questions.text: A company ships goods by truck from Innsbruck to Switzerland. Which transport document is required?
options: Road Consignment Note (CMR)
Inland Waterway Bill of Lading
FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FIATA MTD)
Ocean Bill of Lading (B/L)

questions.text: Which document is used when goods travel combined by truck from Klagenfurt to Trieste and then onward by sea vessel?
options: Air Waybill (AWB)
FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FIATA MTD)
Rail Consignment Note (CIM)
Movement Certificate A.TR
questions.correctAnswer: FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FIATA MTD)

questions.text: What clearly distinguishes a Pro Forma Invoice from a Commercial Invoice?
options: A Pro Forma Invoice is issued after payment and replaces the Certificate of Origin
A Commercial Invoice is used only for customs valuation without payment obligation
Both invoices create the exact same legally binding payment obligation
A Pro Forma Invoice is issued before shipment with no payment obligation for customs or permit purposes
questions.correctAnswer: A Pro Forma Invoice is issued before shipment with no payment obligation for customs or permit purposes

questions.text: What is the purpose of a Movement Certificate (EUR.1 or A.TR) under free trade agreements such as EU-Mexico?
options: It confirms marine insurance coverage at 110 percent of value
It grants duty-free entry or reduced import tariffs in the partner country
It authorizes exports of military drones by the government ministry
It replaces the consignment note for international rail shipments
questions.correctAnswer: It grants duty-free entry or reduced import tariffs in the partner country

questions.text: Under standard bank documentation rules (RLB Upper Austria), what insured amount must a negotiable insurance policy typically cover for CIF/CIP shipments?
options: 110% of the CIF or CIP value
80% of the EXW value
100% of sea freight charges only
150% of customs duty value
questions.correctAnswer: 110% of the CIF or CIP value

questions.text: Schiebel (Wiener Neustadt) exports its Camcopter S-100 helicopter drone. Which document must it obtain from Austria's Federal Ministry of Labour and Economy for each export?
options: A preferential Certificate of Origin GSP Form A
A packing list showing package weights
An export license for military or dual-use high-tech goods
A Forwarders Certificate of Receipt (FCR)
questions.correctAnswer: An export license for military or dual-use high-tech goods

questions.text: International railway shipments (such as a freight train from Romania to Poland) use the Rail Consignment Note (CIM).
A freight forwarder always performs the physical transport itself and never hires external carriers.
Name all six transport modes in foreign trade together with their matching transport document, and briefly explain the purpose of a Certificate of Origin.
questions.correctAnswer: Sea vessel: Bill of Lading (B/L); Inland waterway vessel: Inland Waterway Bill of Lading; Aircraft: Air Waybill (AWB); Railway: Rail Consignment Note (CIM); Truck: Road Consignment Note (CMR); Combined/multimodal transport: FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FIATA MTD). A Certificate of Origin (issued by a Chamber of Commerce) proves the country of manufacture for export and import trade control.
